description:
List all 44 RS3 Grand Exchange category IDs and names to choose a catalogue group. Call with {} and no filters; returns categories sorted by ID from a built-in list, without network access or auth.

Use a returned ID with get_category_info for letter counts, then browse_items for entries. For item-name search use lookup_item. Category IDs identify groups, not items; duplicate category names have distinct IDs.
name: get_all_categories

categories.description: All 44 category references, sorted by ID

title: All Categories
